header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: stood up and asked, “O Messenger of Allah! Who is the most intelligent and the most cautious of people?” The Prophet ﷺ explained, “The one who remembers death the most, and the one who makes the most preparation for it before death (those who do this are the intelligent ones); it is they who have gained the honour of this world and the dignity of the Hereafter.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵁ قَالَ: خَطَّ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ خَطّاً مُرَبَّعاً وَخَطَّ خَطّاً فِي الْوَسَطِ خَارِجاً مِنْهُ، وَخَطَّ خُطَطاً صِغَارًا إِلَي هذَا الَّذِي فِي الْوَسَطِ مِنْ جَانِبِهِ الَّذِي فِي الْوَسَطِ، فَقَالَ: هذَا اْلإِنْسَانُ وَهذَا أَجَلُهُ مُحِيطٌ بِهِ أَوْ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِهِ، وَهذَا الَّذِي هُوَ خَارِجٌ أَمَلُهُ، وَهذِهِ الْخُطَطُ الصِّغَارُ اْلاَعْرَاضُ فَإِنْ أَخْطَأَهُ هذَا نَهَشَهُ هذَا، وَإِنْ أَخْطَأَهُ هذَا نَهَشَهُ هذَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب في الامل وطوله، رقم:٦٤١٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah (RA) narrates, “Once the Messenger of Allah ﷺ drew a line in the shape of a square, drew another line in such a way that it appeared outside that square, then drew small lines inside that square, (the scholars of the Deen have drawn its shape in various ways; one of them is drawn here)

blocks.text: Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “This middle line is the human being; the square line surrounding him on all four sides is his death, from which he can never escape; the line extending out of the square is his worldly hopes, which have gone beyond the limit of his life; all the small lines are his illnesses and troubles; if he escapes from one
